prompt: Gigi brings home the biggest toy box on the street
title: Biggest Toy Box
hook: Big toy box on the street!
irony: Gigi hauls home the biggest toy box to hold each toy, but the emptier the toy box stays, the bigger the fun grows, so the best thing inside is Gigi herself playing.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Gigi drags a giant toy box down the street while Teddy and Benny stare at the tall cardboard sides.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy names toy-box facts, begs for labels on each toy, and refuses to climb in the strange toy box.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox scooters up, boasts his pile is taller, and dares the kids to fill the giant toy box first.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids march round the giant toy box chanting while porch neighbours clap in time.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: On the big-house porch the kids stuff each toy inside until the toy box tips and toys spill.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Knox dives headfirst to prove the biggest fit, sticks upside down, and toys rain onto him while Vera gasps.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids sing round the tipped toy box and the spilled toys scattered on the porch boards.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gigi slumps on the porch step and admits she buys huge toys to feel like the fun one.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gigi dumps the last toys out and Teddy pats room inside the empty toy box for her.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The kids chant round the empty toy box while Gigi climbs inside with open hands to play.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The empty toy box turns into a shared clubhouse as Gigi hands the spilled toys back to play outside.
